blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Make the task and its finish line clear, then check the response against what you actually needed. Good prompting is iterative communication and verification, not a set of magic words.

blocks.title: A flexible checklist
items: Goal: one task and intended outcome
Context: relevant audience, environment, and current behavior
Verify: checks, actual evidence, and uncertainty

blocks.title: Check output twice
items: Structure: required fields, order, and allowed values
Semantics: whether the content correctly completes the task
Examples guide behavior but do not guarantee it
A schema-valid answer can still contain false content

blocks.title: Debug systematically
items: Compare the response with the prompt
Find missing information or contradictory instructions
Change one likely cause at a time
Reuse the same test case and compare results
Keep or revert the change based on evidence

blocks.body: Use only the ingredients that address the task. Their best order and wording can vary, and no prompt removes the need for human review.
